The Taylor RADCycled RG Micro Dot Polo represents our most technical approach to modern golf performance, combining lightweight comfort, unrestricted movement and more thoughtful materials in one of the most versatile polos we make.

Crafted from our proprietary fine-weight performance jersey, it blends certified REPREVE® recycled polyester with stretch yarns to create a fabric that's exceptionally lightweight, breathable and remarkably comfortable. An average Taylor RADCycled Polo incorporates the equivalent of approximately 14 recycled plastic bottles, transforming waste into high-performance yarn designed for years of wear.

The tailored silhouette is designed to wear equally well tucked or untucked, while the refined micro dot pattern adds quiet texture and timeless versatility. Lightweight enough for the warmest rounds, yet polished enough for work, travel and everyday life, the Taylor has become one of the defining performance polos in the RADMOR collection.

title: PING Answer 2D Matte Black (2023) - 34"
body_html:
Workshop Score: 9/10

This putter builds on one of the most iconic shapes in golf history—the Anser—and evolves it into a more stable, modern platform with the 2023 Anser 2D from PING.

The Anser 2D is a thoughtful progression of the classic blade, featuring a wider “D” profile that increases stability without compromising the clean, tour-preferred look at address. Finished in a matte-black head, it presents a sharp, distraction-free visual that frames the ball with intention and contrast.

At the face, PING introduces a PEBAX insert surrounded by shallow-milled grooves—engineered to deliver a softer feel while maintaining consistent ball speeds across the face. The result is a more responsive strike with improved roll characteristics, particularly on putts struck slightly off-center.

The deeper head design significantly increases MOI, giving the Anser 2D a level of forgiveness not typically associated with traditional blades. It’s a subtle shift in geometry that delivers real performance gains—more stability through impact, tighter dispersion, and greater confidence under pressure.

A white sight line contrasts cleanly against the black finish, making alignment intuitive and repeatable. At 34", this setup remains true to a standard, balanced configuration—allowing the design to perform exactly as intended.

It’s a modern Anser—familiar in shape, but meaningfully improved where it matters.

34" standard length

Modern Anser blade with wider “D” profile for added stability

Matte-black finish for reduced glare and clean alignment

PEBAX insert with shallow-milled grooves for soft feel and consistent roll

Increased MOI for enhanced forgiveness vs. standard Anser

High-contrast white sight line for improved aim

Multi-material construction for optimized perimeter weighting

title: Scotty Cameron Super Select Newport 2+ Putter (Custom Build) - 35"
body_html:
Workshop Score: 8.5/10

This putter starts with one of the most trusted shapes in golf—the Newport 2—and evolves it into the slightly wider, more forgiving Newport 2+ platform from Scotty Cameron’s Super Select line.

The “Plus” design introduces a subtly increased flange width, adding stability and forgiveness while maintaining the clean, tour-proven lines that have defined the Newport family for decades. It’s a natural progression for players who love the look and feel of a blade but want just a bit more confidence on off-center strikes.

Milled from 303 stainless steel and paired with a 6061 aircraft-grade aluminum sole plate, the Super Select Newport 2+ redistributes weight to the perimeter—raising MOI without compromising the compact, player-preferred profile. Cameron’s dual-milled face technology refines both sound and feel, delivering a soft, consistent response across the face.

This setup features 10g sole weights, keeping the head balanced and versatile across green speeds and stroke types. Paired with a 35" shaft and a SuperStroke WristLock grip, it’s built to stabilize the hands and quiet excess movement—promoting a more repeatable, square impact.

It’s everything you expect from a Newport 2—just a little more forgiving, and a little more modern.

title: Kerry Mechanical Pencil + Lead Refills (2) + Eraser (2) - Craft Design Technology
body_html:
Kerry Mechanical Pencil Set (038W)

A classic writing instrument, engineered with precision.

Originally introduced in the 1970s by Pentel, the Kerry mechanical pencil was designed around a simple idea: a mechanical pencil that could be carried and used like a fountain pen. This modern edition preserves the original concept while refining its materials and finish.

Metal components give the pencil a balanced, reassuring weight, while the extended drafting-style tip improves visibility and control when writing or sketching. A protective cap—uncommon for mechanical pencils—shields the delicate tip during transport and posts neatly on the back when in use.

The satisfying precision “click” of the cap engaging with the metal body reflects the careful engineering behind the design.

Finished with a glossy white barrel, matte silver cap, and a central brass section detailed with a subtle Sanada-Himo pattern, the pencil offers both grip and visual refinement.

A timeless tool designed for everyday use.

title: Sign & Autograph Pen - Craft Design Technology
body_html:
Sign & Autograph Pen

Fluid lines. No hesitation. A classic writing tool, thoughtfully renewed.

Introduced in 1963 by Pentel, the Sign Pen was designed to be simple, reliable, and easy to use. More than sixty years later, it remains one of the most recognizable water-based ink pens in the world, with over two billion produced and used across more than 100 countries.

This CDT edition preserves the pen’s original form while introducing a subtle refinement. The body is finished in the traditional Japanese color Byakuroku—a soft, fresh green with a pale tone—paired with a matte silver logo that adds quiet contrast.

The defining feature of the Sign Pen is its gently flexible fiber tip. The nib responds naturally to pressure, allowing strokes that taper, curve, and vary in thickness—ideal for expressive handwriting, sketching, and everyday notes.

Filled with bright water-based ink and available in a range of colors—including gray and pink alongside classic black, red, blue, and green—the Sign Pen moves easily between practical use and creative expression.

A simple instrument. Built on decades of trust.

Developed by Pentel, the EnerGel pen is trusted worldwide for its smooth flow and fast-drying gel ink. Since its release in 2000, it has become one of the most widely used writing instruments on the market.

This CDT version pairs Pentel’s advanced ink system with a restrained design—finished in a traditional Japanese black-green tone with metal clip and tip details.

The low-viscosity ink glides easily across the page and dries quickly, allowing clean, uninterrupted writing.

Reliable. Precise. Made for everyday use.

The Studio Set

Good work begins with the right tools.

This set brings together CDT’s most considered essentials: precision scissors, the multifunction Sharbo pen, a notepad, and memo roll—each built with clarity, balance, and restraint.

Nothing decorative. Nothing unnecessary.

Just objects designed to be used—cutting cleanly, writing smoothly, capturing ideas as they arrive.

Wrapped in CDT’s original handkerchief and housed in a textured gift box, it’s a collection that feels as intentional as the work it supports.

For the studio.
For the desk.
For what’s next.

title: Multifunction Pen - Craft Design Technology
body_html:
CDT x Zebra Sharbo + Refill

One tool. Three functions.

Rotate right for mechanical pencil.
Rotate left for ballpoint.
Simple.

Rendered entirely in black or silver, this Sharbo model strips away distraction and focuses on what matters: precision, weight, balance.

Zebra’s emulsion ink combines the fast-drying performance of oil-based ink with the smooth glide of water-based ink. Dark, consistent lines. No interruption. No drag on the page.

A subtle Sanada Himo graphic engraving wraps the body (CDT’s signature design code) adding texture without excess.

Black ink. Red ink. Mechanical pencil.
All housed in a single, considered instrument.

Because good design reduces friction in what you wear, and in how you work.

title: Studio Scissors - Craft Design Technology
body_html:
Studio Scissors

Every process starts with a cut.

Crafted from brushed stainless steel, these scissors are engineered for clean, accurate cuts and long-term durability. The balanced, universal design allows for comfortable use in either hand.

Manufactured in Gifu Prefecture—long regarded as one of Japan’s historic centers of blade craftsmanship—each pair reflects generations of metalworking expertise.

A foundational tool.
Built for the work behind the scenes.

title: Flexible Nib Fountain Pen + Refill - Craft Design Technology
body_html:
Flexible Nib Fountain Pen + Refill

Fluid lines. No hesitation.

This flexible plastic-nib fountain pen is designed by CDT and manufactured by Pentel, Japan for effortless writing and sketching. Pentel’s capillary ink system delivers smooth, consistent flow to the very last drop—no skipping, no drag.

Rich water-based ink dries quickly, making it ideal for notes, sketches, and edits in motion.

Compatible with MLJ20 (Pentel) refills.
Approx. 1,200 meters of writing distance.

A quiet instrument.
Built for clarity of thought.

title: Frixion Ball 3 Pen - Craft Design Technology
body_html:
Frixion Ball 3 + Refill Set

Design is revision.

The CDT Frixion Ball 3 combines three ink colors in one clean instrument—black, red, and blue—each powered by Pilot’s thermo-sensitive gel technology.

Erase with friction. The heat turns ink clear. The page remains intact. No eraser dust. No surface wear.

In design—and in life—clarity often comes after adjustment.

Ideas evolve.
This pen allows them to.

A tool built for iteration, not perfection.

title: Duke Recycled Jacquard Polo - Navy / Slate
body_html:
Introducing the Duke Recycled Jacquard polo shirt, meticulously crafted from our proprietary forty-singles blend of Organic Peruvian Pima Cotton, RadCycled Repreve polyester, and stretch yarns. This exceptional combination offers superior comfort and performance. Our Pima cotton is renowned for its breathability, hypoallergenic properties, and non-GMO, extra-long staple fibers, making it the smoothest and purest cellulose fiber available. It is also biodegradable, emphasizing our commitment to sustainability. The certified Repreve polyester, made from recycled plastic bottles and industrial scrap, adds durability and a modern edge to this classic design. Elevate your wardrobe with a polo that seamlessly blends quality, style, and environmental responsibility.

Note: Jacquard fabrics are woven on a special loom invented by French weaver Joseph Marie Jacquard in 1804. The loom uses a "chain of cards", which is a series of punched cards laced together into a continuous sequence, to control the arrangement of warp and weft yarns to create the desired pattern. Jacquard fabrics can be more expensive than simpler weaves because of the complexity of the patterns and the time and technology required to produce them.

The Five-O Classic Fit Jean is designed for everyday wear with the comfort you don’t expect from a traditional five-pocket jean. This is denim done the RADMOR way — cleaner materials, thoughtful design, and comfort that lasts.



Note: Scott Morrison (one of our Co-Founders) started Paper Denim, Earnest Sewn, and 3x1 Denim - so making jeans is something we've been doing well since 1999.


How to Pick the Perfect Size? If you wash frequently (after a wear or two) then buy your usual size. All denim stretches out a bit after wearing, and these are designed to 'recover' after washing. Now, If you like your jeans to fit a bit more snug, or if you go longer between washings, then we recommend buying a size smaller than your typical pant size. Enjoy and wear often!

The Stewart Recycled Jacquard Long Sleeve Polo
Performance meets polish — sustainably.

Crafted from our proprietary blend of Organic Peruvian Pima Cotton, certified REPREVE® recycled polyester, and Spandex stretch yarns, the Stewart is built for cooler rounds, sharper looks, and long-lasting comfort. The jacquard knit adds subtle texture and elevated style, while the fine forty-singles construction delivers softness you can feel with every wear.

Our Pima cotton is ultra-breathable, hypoallergenic, and spun from non-GMO, extra-long staple fibers — aka the gold standard in cotton. Add in REPREVE® fibers made from recycled plastic bottles and industrial waste, and you've got a shirt that looks good, feels good, and does good.

From fairways to fall layers, the Stewart Long Sleeve is the versatile staple you didn’t know you were missing.


Note: Jacquard fabrics are woven on a special loom invented by French weaver Joseph Marie Jacquard in 1804. The loom uses a "chain of cards", which is a series of punched cards laced together into a continuous sequence, to control the arrangement of warp and weft yarns to create the desired pattern. Jacquard fabrics can be more expensive than simpler weaves because of the complexity of the patterns and the time and technology required to produce them.

Note: A 10k/10k waterproof rating plays a significant role in determining the level of protection offered by your rain gear. The first number in the rating, 10k, refers to the water column pressure. It represents the amount of water in millimeters that can be exerted on the fabric before water starts to penetrate through it. This garment can withstand a water column pressure of 10,000mm before water penetrates the fabric. The second number in the rating, also 10k, refers to breathability. It indicates the amount of moisture in grams that can pass through a square meter of fabric in a 24-hour period. This measurement is crucial for golf as it allows moisture generated by your body to escape from the inside of the garment.

title: Five-O Knit Pant
body_html:
Five-O Knit Pant

The Five-O Knit Pant is our modern re-engineering of the classic five-pocket pant—clean, refined, and built for all-day comfort. Designed with a tailored slim silhouette and a polished, everyday look, it delivers the ease of a sweatpant with the structure of a trouser.

It’s made from a premium cellulose-based cotton knit blended with Elastane stretch yarns. Because it’s knit—not woven—the fabric moves naturally with the body, offering true four-way stretch, exceptional softness, and a level of comfort that traditional five-pocket pants simply can’t match.

The cotton base provides breathability and a smooth hand feel, while Elastane delivers flexibility, shape retention, and recovery. The result is a pant that flexes when you move, holds its shape when you don’t, and feels broken-in from the very first wear.

Finished with our signature “O” (ball pocket) pocket on the back right, the Five-O blends functional detail with quiet design character. Wear it on the course, to the office, on a plane, or out to dinner—this is the pant that does everything without looking like it’s trying.

As with all RADMOR apparel, the Five-O is mindfully designed to reduce the long-term impact of clothing on landfills, using durable construction and responsible materials that are built to last.

Built-in stretch mesh undershorts and pocket bags add breathable comfort and freedom of movement, keeping you supported without restriction. Clean lines, thoughtful construction, and easy performance make the Hannah a go-to on the course — and well beyond it.

title: Colton Recycled Rib Quarter 1/4 Zip
body_html:
Colton Recycled Rib Jersey 1/4 Zip

The Colton 1/4 Zip is a modern performance essential—clean, versatile, and built for everyday movement. Designed with a refined ribbed texture and a streamlined silhouette, it delivers effortless style with real comfort and performance built in.

It’s crafted from a thirty-singles (30/1) light-weight rib jersey made with a proprietary blend of certified REPREVE recycled polyester, Peruvian Pima cotton, modal, and Elastane stretch yarns. The fabric is exceptionally soft, breathable, and naturally stretchy, with a smooth hand feel and a refined drape that holds its shape throughout the day.

REPREVE fibers are spun from recycled plastic bottles, helping reduce landfill waste and environmental impact. Peruvian Pima cotton adds signature softness and breathability. Modal enhances smoothness and moisture management. Elastane provides just the right amount of stretch for unrestricted movement and all-day comfort.

Finished with a clean quarter-zip neckline, the Colton transitions effortlessly from the course to travel to everyday wear. Layer it over a tee, under a jacket, or wear it solo. However you style it, this is a modern knit built for comfort, versatility, and a lighter footprint on the planet.

title: RADMerino Cashmere Blend Sweater Crew
body_html:
RADMerino Cashmere Blend Crew Sweater

The RADMerino Cashmere Blend Crew represents our belief that the best golf sweaters should feel as appropriate at dinner as they do on the first tee.

Crafted from our proprietary RADMerino yarn, a luxurious blend of 90% premium merino wool and 10% cashmere, it delivers exceptional softness, natural warmth and remarkable breathability in a sweater designed to be worn throughout the changing seasons. Lightweight yet insulating, it comfortably regulates body temperature while remaining naturally odor-resistant, making it as practical for travel as it is elegant for everyday wear.

Merino wool has long been prized for its ability to adapt to changing conditions, keeping you warm when temperatures fall while remaining comfortable as the day warms. The addition of fine cashmere lends an unmistakable softness and refined hand, creating a sweater that feels luxurious from the very first wear and only becomes better with time.

The subtle honeycomb knit adds texture and depth while allowing the sweater to breathe naturally, creating a clean, tailored silhouette that layers effortlessly over a polo or beneath a jacket. Whether worn for an early autumn round, a weekend away or an evening out, the RADMerino Crew is designed to become one of the most versatile pieces in your wardrobe.

Simple, versatile, and thoughtfully finished — the Chappie is designed to live in your rotation, not sit in your closet.
